161 //
162 // counts the number of lines in one directive
163 //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
164 int Unparser::line_count(char* directive) {
165  int lines = 1;
166 
167  for (int i = 0; directive[i] != '\0'; i++) {
168  if (directive[i] == '\n')
169  lines++;
170  }
171  return lines;
172 }

1029 
1030  return line;

1306  /* Genenerate an ASCII dump of the entire file contents. Generate the dump before unparsing because unparsing may perform
1307  * certain relocations and normalization to the AST. */
1308  // DQ (8/30/2008): This is temporary, we should review how we want to name the files
1309  // generated in the unparse phase of processing a binary.
1310  file->dumpAll(true, ".dump");

1312  /* Generate file name for uparser output */
1313  // DQ (8/30/2008): This is temporary, we should review how we want to name the files
1314  // generated in the unparse phase of processing a binary.
1315  std::string output_name = file->get_name() + ".new";
1316  size_t slash = output_name.find_last_of('/');
1317  if (slash!=output_name.npos)
1318  output_name.replace(0, slash+1, "");
1319  if (SgProject::get_verbose() >= 1)
1320  std::cout << "output re-generated binary as: " << output_name << std::endl;

1326 void
1327 Unparser::unparseFile(SgBinaryComposite *binary, SgUnparse_Info &info)
1328 {
1329  if ( SgProject::get_verbose() > 0 )
1330  {
1331  printf ("In Unparser::unparseFile(SgBinaryComposite *binary, SgUnparse_Info &info): file = %p = %s \n",binary,binary->class_name().c_str());
1332  }
1333 
1334  ASSERT_not_null(binary);
1335  ASSERT_require(binary->get_binary_only()) ;
1336 
1337  /* Unparse each file and create an ASCII dump as well */
1338  const SgAsmGenericFilePtrList &files = binary->get_genericFileList()->get_files();
1339  ROSE_ASSERT(!files.empty());
1340 
1341  for (size_t i=0; i<files.size(); i++) {
1342  unparseAsmFile(files[i], info);
1343  }
1344 
1345  // Generate an ASCII dump of disassembled instructions for interpretations that we didn't already dump in `uparseAsmFile`. In
1346  // other words, dump interpretations that span multiple files.
1347  //
1348  // [Robb Matzke 2024-10-18]: There are better ways of producing assembly listings, but they don't generally work directly on an
1349  // AST. See Rose::BinaryAnalysis::Unparser.
1350  size_t nwritten = 0;
1351  const SgAsmInterpretationPtrList &interps = binary->get_interpretations()->get_interpretations();
1352  for (SgAsmInterpretation *interp: interps) {
1353  SgAsmGenericFilePtrList interp_files = interp->get_files();
1354  if (interp_files.size() > 1) {
1355  const std::string interp_name = (boost::format("interp-%03zu.dump") % nwritten++).str();
1356  std::ofstream output(interp_name.c_str());
1357  ASSERT_require(output);
1358  output <<"Interpretation spanning these input files:\n";
1359  for (SgAsmGenericFile *interp_file: interp_files)
1360  output <<" " <<interp_file->get_name() <<"\n";
1361  AST::Traversal::forwardPre<SgAsmInstruction>(interp, [&output](SgAsmInstruction *insn) {
1362  output <<insn->toString() <<"\n";
1363  });
1364  }
1365  }
1366 
1367  /* Generate the rose_*.s (get_unparse_output_filename()) assembly file. It will contain all the interpretations. */
1368  // [Robb Matzke 2024-10-18]: There are better ways to make assembly listings, but you need a Partitioner object.
1369  if (binary->get_unparse_output_filename() != "") {
1370  std::ofstream asm_file(binary->get_unparse_output_filename().c_str());
1371  if (asm_file) {
1372  for (size_t i = 0; i < interps.size(); ++i) {
1373  AST::Traversal::forwardPre<SgAsmInstruction>(interps[i], [&asm_file](SgAsmInstruction *insn) {
1374  asm_file <<insn->toString() <<"\n";
1375  });
1376  }
1377  }
1378  }
1379 }

1381 void
1382 Unparser::unparseFile(SgJvmComposite* jvm, SgUnparse_Info &)
1383 {
1384  ASSERT_not_null(jvm);
1385  std::vector<SgAsmGenericFile*> files{};
1386 
1387  // Make sure the files are in the file system and not a jar file
1388  for (auto file : jvm->get_genericFileList()->get_files()) {
1389  auto path = file->get_name();
1390  if (boost::filesystem::exists(path)) {
1391  if (!CommandlineProcessing::isJavaJarFile(path)) {
1392  files.push_back(file);

1394  }
1395  }
1396 
1397  /* Can only unparse one file at the moment */
1398  // SgJvmComposite designed for multiple interpretations, not multiple files
1399  ASSERT_require(files.size() < 2);
1400 
1401  for (auto file : files) {
1402  if (CommandlineProcessing::isJavaJarFile(jvm->get_unparse_output_filename())) {
1403  // Don't unparse jar files (and can only unparse one file currently)
1404  return;
1405  }
1406  // Note: jvm->get_unparse_output_filename() is problematic because may not match file's name
1407  SgAsmExecutableFileFormat::unparseBinaryFormat(jvm->get_unparse_output_filename(), file);
1408  }
1409 }

1433  switch ( statement->variantT() )

1440  default:

1444  printf ("In unparseStatementWithoutBasicBlockToString(): statementString = %s \n",statementString.c_str());

1492 string
1493 unparseDeclarationToString ( SgDeclarationStatement* declaration, bool unparseAsDeclaration )
1494  {
1495  // This function generates a string for a declaration. The string is required for
1496  // the intermediate file to make sure that all transformation code will compile
1497  // (since it could depend on declarations defined within the code).
1498 
1499  // Details:
1500  // 1) Only record declarations found within the source file (exclude all header files
1501  // since they will be seen when the same header files are included).
1502  // 2) Resort the variable declarations to remove redundent entries.
1503  // WRONG: variable declarations could have dependences upon class declarations!
1504  // 3) Don't sort all declarations since some could have dependences.
1505  // a) class declarations
1506  // b) typedefs
1507  // c) function declarations
1508  // d) template declarations
1509  // e) variable definition???
1510 
1511  // ASSERT_not_null(this);
1512  ASSERT_not_null( declaration);
1513 
1514 #if 0
1515  printf ("generateDeclarationToString(): unparseAsDeclaration = %s declaration->sage_class_name() = %s \n",
1516  unparseAsDeclaration ? "true" : "false",declaration->sage_class_name());
1517 #endif
1518 
1519  string declarationString;
1520 
1521  // Build a SgUnparse_Info object to represent formatting options for
1522  // this statement (use the default values).
1523  SgUnparse_Info info;
1524 
1525  // exclude comments
1526  info.set_SkipComments();
1527 
1528  // exclude all CPP directives (since they have already been evaluated by the front-end)
1529  info.set_SkipCPPDirectives();
1530 
1531  switch ( declaration->variantT() )
1532  {
1533  // Enum declarations should not skip their definition since
1534  // this is where the constants are declared.
1535  case V_SgEnumDeclaration:
1536 
1537  case V_SgVariableDeclaration:
1538  case V_SgTemplateDeclaration:
1539  case V_SgTypedefDeclaration:
1540  // Need to figure out if a forward declaration would work or be
1541  // more conservative and always output the complete class definition.
1542 
1543  // turn off output of initializer values
1544  info.set_SkipInitializer();
1545  // output the declaration as a string
1546  declarationString = globalUnparseToString(declaration,&info);
1547  break;
1548 
1549  case V_SgClassDeclaration:
1550  // Need to figure out if a forward declaration would work or be
1551  // more conservative and always output the complete class definition.
1552 
1553  // turn off the generation of the function definitions only
1554  // (we still want the restof the class definition since these
1555  // define all member data and member functions).
1556  info.set_SkipFunctionDefinition();
1557  info.set_AddSemiColonAfterDeclaration();
1558 
1559  if (unparseAsDeclaration == false)
1560  {
1561  info.set_SkipClassDefinition();
1562  }
1563  else
1564  {
1565 // info.set_AddSemiColonAfterDeclaration();
1566  }
1567 
1568  // output the declaration as a string
1569  declarationString = globalUnparseToString(declaration,&info);
1570  break;
1571 
1572  // For functions just output the declaration and skip the definition
1573  // (This also avoids the generation of redundent definitions since the
1574  // function we are in when we generate all declarations would be included).
1575  case V_SgMemberFunctionDeclaration:
1576  case V_SgFunctionDeclaration:
1577  {
1578  // turn off the generation of the definition
1579  info.set_SkipFunctionDefinition();
1580 
1581  // unparse with the ";" (as a declaration) or unparse without the ";"
1582  // as a function for which we will attach a local scope (basic block).
1583  // printf ("In generateDeclarationString(): unparseAsDeclaration = %s \n",(unparseAsDeclaration) ? "true" : "false");
1584  if (unparseAsDeclaration == true)
1585  info.set_AddSemiColonAfterDeclaration();
1586 
1587  // output the declaration as a string
1588  declarationString = globalUnparseToString(declaration,&info);
1589  break;
1590  }
1591 
1592  case V_SgFunctionParameterList:
1593  {
1594  // Handle generation of declaration strings this case differently from unparser
1595  // since want to generate declaration strings and not function parameter lists
1596  // (function parameter lists would be delimited by "," while declarations would
1597  // be delimited by ";").
1598  SgFunctionParameterList* parameterListDeclaration = dynamic_cast<SgFunctionParameterList*>(declaration);
1599  ASSERT_not_null(parameterListDeclaration);
1600  SgInitializedNamePtrList & argList = parameterListDeclaration->get_args();
1601  SgInitializedNamePtrList::iterator i;
1602  for (i = argList.begin(); i != argList.end(); i++)
1603  {
1604 // printf ("START: Calling unparseToString on type! \n");
1605  ASSERT_not_null((*i));
1606  string typeNameString = (*i)->get_type()->unparseToString();
1607 // printf ("DONE: Calling unparseToString on type! \n");
1608 
1609  string variableName;
1610  if ( (*i)->get_name().getString() != "")
1611  {
1612  variableName = (*i)->get_name().str();
1613  declarationString += typeNameString + " " + variableName + "; ";
1614  }
1615  else
1616  {
1617  // Don't need the tailing ";" if there is no variable name (I think)
1618  declarationString += typeNameString + " ";
1619  }
1620  }
1621  break;
1622  }
1623 
1624  // ignore this case ... not really a declaration
1625  case V_SgCtorInitializerList:
1626  // printf ("Ignore the SgCtorInitializerList (constructor initializer list) \n");
1627  break;
1628 
1629  case V_SgVariableDefinition:
1630  printf ("ERROR: SgVariableDefinition nodes not used in AST \n");
1631  ROSE_ABORT();
1632  break;
1633 
1634  // DQ (7/31/2006): Suggested additions by Markus Schordan.
1635  case V_SgPragma:
1636  break;
1637  case V_SgPragmaDeclaration:
1638  break;
1639 
1640  // default case should always be an error
1641  default:
1642  printf ("Default reached in AST_Rewrite::AccumulatedDeclarationsAttribute::generateDeclarationString() \n");
1643  printf (" declaration->sage_class_name() = %s \n",declaration->sage_class_name());
1644  ROSE_ABORT();
1645  break;
1646  }
1647 
1648  // Add a space to make it easier to read (not required)
1649  declarationString += " ";
1650 
1651  // printf ("For this scope: declarationString = %s \n",declarationString.c_str());
1652 
1653  return declarationString;
1654  }

1657 string
1658 Unparser::removeUnwantedWhiteSpace ( const string & X )
1659  {
1660  string returnString;
1661  int stringLength = X.length();
1662 
1663  for (int i=0; i < stringLength; i++)
1664  {
1665  if ( (X[i] != ' ') && (X[i] != '\n') )
1666  {
1667  returnString += X[i];
1668  }
1669  else
1670  {
1671  if ( (i > 0) && (X[i] == ' ') &&
1672  ( (X[i-1] != ' ') && (X[i-1] != '\n') && (X[i-1] != '{') && (X[i-1] != ';') && (X[i-1] != '}')) )
1673  {
1674  if ( (i < stringLength-1) && (X[i] == ' ') && (X[i+1] != '(') )
1675  returnString += X[i];
1676  }
1677  }
1678  }
1679 
1680  return returnString;
1681  }

1721 // DQ (5/8/2010): Added support to force unparser to reset the source positon in the AST (this is the only side-effect in unparsing).
1723 void
1724 Unparser::resetSourcePosition (SgStatement* stmt)
1725  {
1726  static int previous_line_number = 0;
1727  static int previous_column_number = 0;
1728 
1729  Sg_File_Info* originalFileInfo = stmt->get_file_info();
1730  ASSERT_not_null(originalFileInfo);
1731 
1732  if ( SgProject::get_verbose() > 0 )
1733  printf ("Reset the source code position from %s:%d:%d to ",originalFileInfo->get_filename(),originalFileInfo->get_line(),originalFileInfo->get_col());
1734 
1735  // This is the current output file.
1736  // string newFilename = "output";
1737  // Detect reuse of an Unparser object with a different file
1738  ASSERT_not_null(currentFile);
1739  string newFilename = get_output_filename(*currentFile);

1763 resetSourcePositionToGeneratedCode( SgFile* file, UnparseFormatHelp *unparseHelp )
1764  {
1765  // DQ (5/8/2010): This function uses the unparsing operation to record the locations of
1766  // the unparsed language constructs and reset the source code position to that of the
1767  // generated code.
1768 
1769  // DQ (4/22/2006): This can be true when the "-E" option is used, but then we should not have called this function!

1773  ROSE_ASSERT (file->get_binary_only() == false);

1775  // If we did unparse an intermediate file then we want to compile that file instead of the original source file.
1776  string outputFilename;
1777  if (file->get_unparse_output_filename().empty() == true)
1778  {
1779  outputFilename = "rose_" + file->get_sourceFileNameWithoutPath();
1780 
1781  if (file->get_binary_only() == true)
1782  {
1783  outputFilename += ".s";
1784  }
1785 
1786  // DQ (4/2/2011): Java output files must have the same name as the class and so all we can do is use the same name but put the generated file into the compile tree.
1787  // Note that if the generated file is put into the source tree it will overwite the original source file.
1788  if (file->get_Java_only() == true)
1789  {
1790  outputFilename = file->get_sourceFileNameWithoutPath();
1791 
1792  printf ("Warning, output file name of generated Java code is same as input file name but must be but into a separate directory. \n");
1793  ROSE_ABORT();
1794  }
1795  }
1796  else
1797  {
1798  outputFilename = file->get_unparse_output_filename();
1799  }

1801  // Set the output file name, since this may be called before unparse().
1802  file->set_unparse_output_filename(outputFilename);
1803  ROSE_ASSERT (file->get_unparse_output_filename().empty() == false);
1804 
1805  printf ("Exiting output file name of generated Java code is same as input file name but must be but into a separate directory. \n");
1806  ROSE_ABORT();
1807 
1808  // Name the file with a separate extension.
1809  outputFilename += ".resetSourcePosition";
1810 
1811  // printf ("Inside of resetSourcePositionToGeneratedCode(UnparseFormatHelp*) outputFilename = %s \n",outputFilename.c_str());
1812 
1813  if ( SgProject::get_verbose() > -1 )
1814  printf ("Calling the resetSourcePositionToGeneratedCode: outputFilename = %s \n",outputFilename.c_str());
1815 
1816  fstream ROSE_OutputFile(outputFilename.c_str(),ios::out);
1817 
1818  if (!ROSE_OutputFile)
1819  {
1820  // throw std::exception("(fstream) error while opening file.");
1821  printf ("Error detected in opening file %s for output \n",outputFilename.c_str());
1822  ROSE_ABORT();
1823  }
1824 
1825  ROSE_ASSERT(ROSE_OutputFile);
1826 
1827  // all options are now defined to be false. When these options can be passed in
1828  // from the prompt, these options will be set accordingly.
1829  bool UseAutoKeyword = false;

1831 
1832  // DQ (6/19/2007): note that test2004_24.C will fail if this is false.

1836  bool num = false;

1840 
1841  bool caststring = false;
1842  bool _debug = false;
1843  bool _class = false;
1844  bool _forced_transformation_format = false;

1846  // control unparsing of include files into the source file (default is false)

1848 
1849  Unparser_Opt roseOptions( UseAutoKeyword,
1850  generateLineDirectives,
1851  useOverloadedOperators,
1852  num,
1853  _this,
1854  caststring,
1855  _debug,
1856  _class,

1861

1863  roseUnparser.set_embedColorCodesInGeneratedCode ( file->get_embedColorCodesInGeneratedCode() );

4260  // are associated with these limits. It uses a traversal to evaluate the statements (and the associated
4261  // source sequence number for each statement) against the limits for each file.

5554  // DQ (3/11/2020): The transformation of header files causes them to be output into a separate directory location.
5555  // The paths associated with each transformed header file must be saved so that then can be output on the compile
5556  // line for the generated source files. The current design supports an extra include path list so that we can support
5557  // the specification of the paths to the transformed header files ahead of the source file's original include path list.
5558  // However, the extra include paths are strored in the SgSourceFile IR nodes, and there can be more than one source
5559  // file that is required to support the include path list that includes the paths to the transformed header files.
5560  // Not clear which is the best way to support this.
5561  // 1) Currently we build the list in the SgSourceFile for the include file to have a modified extra include path list,
5562  // however, this is pointless since the header files are not compiled. And it is insufficient because the source
5563  // files that are compiled don't have the correct extra include path entries.
5564  // 2) We could store the extra include paths as they are built up in this function, but I don't think this function
5565  // is calling the backend compiler.
5566  // 3) We could build the list of the source files to be compiled, but this might not be a great solution since it
5567  // would cause every source file to have the same extra include paths.
5568  // 4) (best idea so far) We need to add a second extra list of include paths to the SgProject object, then when
5569  // building the include list for each file we can first (or second) include the paths from the SgProject's extra
5570  // include paths list before adding those specific to the SgSourceFile.
